theta_grid: linspace(-5,5,401), spacing 0.025, used for grid-EAP posterior
update_rule_description: Grid-based EAP (expected a posteriori). Log-posterior over a 401-point theta grid initialized to the N(0,1) log-prior; after each administered item the item's exact log-likelihood at the observed simulated response is added to the grid log-posterior; theta_hat = posterior mean = sum(theta*posterior). Item selection at each step uses the item with max Fisher information evaluated at the CURRENT theta_hat (theta_hat=0 at step 1). Posterior precision accumulates the selection-time Fisher info: precision = 1 + sum(info_at_theta_hat_when_selected); reliability = 1 - 1/precision (standardized-factor reliability, prior precision 1).
response_generation: Model-based at the patient's TRUE theta: gaussian ~ N(alpha+lam*theta, sigma); bernoulli ~ Bern(sigmoid(alpha+lam*theta)); ordinal ~ graded-response categories (eta=lam*theta, alpha absorbed by cutpoints, matching the reference info recipe); count ~ NegBinom(mean=exp(alpha+lam*theta), r=count_alpha).
info_recipe_provenance: Generalized from article/figures/scripts/fig_adaptive_assessment.py item_info_on_factor; verified to reduce EXACTLY (within float32, maxdiff 2.8e-7) to that reference at theta=0 for every pool item. Upper-bound curves reproduce curves8; immuno 3-item worked example and mania(0.408)/substance(0.429) ceilings match the published figure.
assumptions: Single-factor (1-D) CAT per axis, matching how the population-mean upper-bound curves are defined; cross-factor correlations (Phi) are NOT used in the per-axis reliability (both methods on identical footing).
Ordinal linear predictor excludes alpha (cutpoints absorb location) exactly as the reference info fn does.

Reliability averaged across patients at each step count (per task spec); note reliability is concave in precision so this is the mean realized reliability, not reliability at mean precision. Observed CAT-vs-fixed-order divergence exceeds 0.0005 only on the two Bernoulli-containing banks: suicidality (-0.012 at 2 items, then +0.003 beyond 4) and substance (+0.0015 at the 4-item cap); all other axes match to within 0.0002 because their information-driving items are Gaussian (theta-independent info).
Fisher info for selection & precision uses the observed-information proxy = expected info at theta_hat (standard CAT test-information); it is theta-independent for gaussian items.

ceiling_definition: Per-axis 'ceiling' = full-item-bank reliability (reliability when the ENTIRE candidate pool is administered, = 1 - 1/(1+sum of all pool-item info at the population mean)).
